CA.rationale: No explicit attention/processing relation to contents was present.

COD.rationale: Content (red set) is listed, its presentation/organization is given (grid layout/full-set), and an origin/status field is present for the same referent/time.

A.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation or content-processing relation to the listed content was present.

C.rationale: The report identifies specific content sets (e.g. red coordinates) for named referents.

D.rationale: An origin/status field is provided separately from the content listing for the same referent, distinguishing content identity from its provenance/status.

O.rationale: The text specifies how content is presented/organized (coordinate orientation and explicit coordinate sets).
